# Baseline A Narrative Synthesis: Linear Orbit, Inc.

Case: dev-saas-linear-2023
Cutoff: 2023-09-14
Input fingerprint: 1a0b3b0cacf1

## Narrative
- Linear Orbit, Inc. is summarized from 2 cutoff-visible public evidence records dated on or before 2023-09-14.
- The normalized claim list contains 9 cited observations from source classes: company-primary, news.
- Forbes named customers including Cohere, Ramp and Runway in its Linear profile.
- Forbes reported Linear was profitable around the Series B announcement.
- Forbes reported that the Series B valued Linear at about USD 400 million.
- Linear announced a USD 35 million Series B on 2023-09-14.
- Linear said Sequoia, 01 Advisors and individual software operators participated in the Series B.

## Evidence Notes
- Linear raises USD 35M Series B led by Accel [ev-7cdb351de312]

  - Linear said Sequoia, 01 Advisors and individual software operators participated in the Series B. (value=Sequoia, 01 Advisors, software operator angels; period=instant 2023-09-14)
  - Linear said it had been growing and operating profitably since 2021. (value=profitable since 2021; period=start 2021-01-01, end 2023-09-14)
  - Linear said it was a team of 50 people on 2023-09-14. (value=50; unit=employees; period=instant 2023-09-14)
  - Linear said it was trusted and used by thousands of companies of all sizes. (value=thousands of companies; period=instant 2023-09-14)
  - Linear said the Series B was led by Accel. (value=Accel; period=instant 2023-09-14)
- Linear developer tools raise USD 35 million Series B [ev-d9970e2872b9]
  - Forbes named customers including Cohere, Ramp and Runway in its Linear profile. (value=Cohere, Ramp, Runway; period=instant 2023-09-14)
  - Forbes reported Linear was profitable around the Series B announcement. (value=true; period=instant 2023-09-14)
  - Forbes reported that the Series B valued Linear at about USD 400 million. (value=400; unit=USD millions headline valuation; period=instant 2023-09-14)

## Limitations
- This baseline performs deterministic evidence summarization only.
- It does not run TRACE route selection, sufficiency gating, valuation logic, or adversarial review.
